findings.fonts: System serif stack (Iowan/Palatino/Georgia) and system sans; no package.json or font dependency.
findings.palette: Warm paper and wine accent with a matching dark theme, duplicated across home.css and styles.css.
findings.motion: Vanilla CSS transitions and reduced-motion rules; no motion library.
findings.spacing: Plain CSS with local layout tokens; no shared spacing scale or framework.
findings.framework: Static HTML, CSS and JavaScript; index.html library, reader.html reader; offline and dependency-free per ../README.md.

preserve: All existing volume content, copy, statistics, covers and illustrations
Library, chapter navigation, URLs, settings, saved positions, encrypted chunk loading and scene timeline behavior
Offline static delivery and the light/dark reading themes
introduce: A coherent tokenized visual system across the library and reader
A complete editorial redesign of the bookshelf, reading shell, chapter flow, focus reader and settings
